selection: Lowest- and highest-BMI engine-admissible HAALSI bodies within each sex in the fixed Stage 2 anonymous sample, restricted to ages 40-65; pressure was not used for selection.
disclosure_note: Demographics are coarsened for publication (age, height and weight to the nearest 5 y/cm/kg). The studies were run on exact cohort-derived values that are not redistributed; see docs/DATA_DE_IDENTIFICATION.md.
